title: Attention Is All You Need, arXiv first version
lineage: First manuscript version dated 12 June 2017; describes attention-based encoder-decoder Transformer and reports 28.4 BLEU English–German and 41.0 BLEU English–French on WMT 2014. Later versions report different figures.
